items.title: Why Day and Night results can show different dates
items.summary: Day and Night are separate Virginia drawings with separate results. When the later drawing has not happened yet, or has not been published, LotteryCorner keeps showing the most recent completed result for that drawing rather than blanking the row.
takeaways: Each drawing keeps its own result date.
A row is never filled from its sibling drawing.
Check the label above the numbers before comparing a ticket.

items.title: How Virginia draw times are shown
items.summary: Draw times on this page are shown in Eastern Time (ET), the time zone Virginia drawings are held in. Each game row carries its own published draw time so you can tell which drawing a result belongs to.
takeaways: All times on this page are ET.
Each game row shows its own draw time.
An exact date is always shown, never “today” or “last night”.

items.title: Claiming a Virginia prize
items.summary: LotteryCorner has its own short video on how Virginia prizes are claimed. Because claim rules change, we point you to it rather than restating amounts or deadlines we have not re-checked.
takeaways: Official claim authority stays with the state lottery.

items.title: What Fireball means in Virginia Pick 3 games
items.summary: Fireball is a separately drawn add-on shown beside the main numbers. It is not an extra ordinary winning ball, and it only applies when the ticket includes the add-on.
takeaways: It applies only when the ticket includes the add-on.
It is never counted as one of the main numbers.

items.title: How Virginia Cash Pop drawings are grouped
items.summary: Cash Pop runs several drawings a day. LotteryCorner shows them as one game with a labelled row per drawing, in a fixed order, so the page does not become a wall of near-identical cards.
takeaways: Rows stay in the same order every visit.
Each row carries its own date and number.
